Identification and arrest of kingpins, big suppliers, major transporters/peddlers

rationale: C3 is a budget announcement of an interest subsidy (not interest-free loans) with an allocation; C1 repeats it as announced. No GO or launch shown.

rationale: C2 (GO of 2026-07-24) states the White Paper on fiscal management was published in June 2026; C3 and the Governor's address (C1) confirm release and cover debt and revenue. Scope broadly matches.

rationale: C1 is a budget speech statement urging the Union to cancel NEET; no Assembly resolution, letter or GO is shown. Policy note C3 only states the government's view.

No extract describes an awareness campaign against burning agricultural waste; climate literacy and forest fire campaigns are unrelated.

cited.quote: This Government will work diligently to continuously press the Union Government to safeguard the welfare of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states intent to press the Union and to form a legal committee, in future tense. No letter, resolution or GO is shown.

rationale: C1 says a report on Union devolution will be published; it is not shown as released. The white paper concerns the state's own finances.
No extract concerns a Rs.1,000 duty allowance for police personnel; C1 covers prison risk allowance and C3 the ANTF budget.

cited.quote: providing cutting-edge infrastructure and incubation for startups and researchers in the VFX and gaming sectors

rationale: C1 and C2 cover urban slum-free housing generally; none creates a coastal housing scheme. A general scheme (My-Home) does not fulfil it.
